hypothesis: Per the ESMM/MMoE literature notes (both flagged `is_like`/`is_comment` as natural auxiliary signals logged on the same rows as `long_view`), add a second, auxiliary prediction head (`is_like`) that shares the FM's embedding table `V` with the main `long_view` BPR head but has its own linear weights/bias, trained jointly via a small-weight pointwise BCE loss added to the BPR loss. This regularizes the shared user/video embeddings with a second, less-noisy gradient signal instead of just adding raw capacity, which is the untried lever after 5 straight capacity-only rejections.
reflection: FwFM's per-field-pair weights gave essentially zero change (0.6034 vs 0.6035) and again showed the now-familiar overfitting shape (peak mid-training, degrade after) — but since early stopping already restores the best epoch's weights, that peak value itself is the real ceiling, meaning the last several capacity-only tweaks (k sweep, FwFM, DeepFM MLP) all cap out at essentially the same peak regardless of extra parameters. That points away from "more pairwise-interaction capacity" and toward needing a different regularizing signal on the shared embeddings rather than more capacity within the same signal.
expected_effect: GAUC should move more than nDCG@5, since the auxiliary signal directly regularizes the shared embedding table that produces the pairwise interaction score GAUC evaluates, whereas nDCG@5's top-5 cutoff is a more indirect downstream consequence of the same embeddings.
